description: This file contains CSS styles primarily for managing themes in a React application. It defines CSS variables for light and dark themes, controls layout and appearance for various components, and includes styles for responsive design.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Styles for the main application container including background color and color theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styles for the logo in the application, including animation effects.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the header section of the application, including layout and background color.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links in the application, with color transitions.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button, including positioning and hover effects.
